premises.text: A multi-sensor device (nine sensors) captures many clinical health metrics in about 60 seconds like a digital thermometer, including cuffless blood pressure
premises.evidence_span: It's nine integrated sensors and analytics. It's able to track 33 different health metrics. It works just as simple as a digital thermometer, and it takes only 60 seconds to get it done

premises.text: The device syncs to mobile devices via Bluetooth or a 3G Wi-Fi cradle and produces a 0–100 health score/grade
premises.evidence_span: It can communicate to any mobile device via Bluetooth, or it can also talk to a 3G Wi-Fi sanitizing cradle

premises.text: Analytics can alert care facilities to undetected abnormalities (e.g., arrhythmia) enabling specialist referral
premises.evidence_span: our analytic software was able to identify and alert the facility of two abnormalities

premises.text: Target markets include elderly care, chronic-disease remote monitoring (state/Medicare reimbursement), hospital discharge/readmission prevention, and consumers
premises.evidence_span: In addition to elderly care, there are many other markets that we can go into. We can help companies that focus on chronic disease care

premises.text: Revenue model combines subscription, OEM/licensing, and eventual data mining
premises.evidence_span: Through subscription base, OEM and licensing revenue, which in fact we're just about to close such an agreement for China market, and of course eventually data mining

value.text: Empower people and caregivers to take control of health through easy preventive monitoring
value.evidence_span: empowering you to take control of your health

secondary_value.text: Avoid pain/suffering and system cost from undetected conditions such as stroke
secondary_value.evidence_span: not just the money saved, but the pain and suffering that is avoided by the patient and the family

causal_links.evidence_span: Having the ability to track their health has dramatic implication on the quality of the care they're going to receive
A true step forward in preventive care
more individuals want to be empowered to better understand and control their own health

notes: 33 metrics and named indices folded into one sensor measurement package (§4.1.7/8). Connectivity+score kept with device surface. Pilot case counts and stroke cost figures excluded as traction/impact sizing. Market list treated as one GTM portfolio condition; China OEM mention folded into licensing revenue premise.
